nome: inemaSEO 5 — With Agents: Claude Code and Codex Doing the Repetitive Work

lado_card.texto: With agents doing the repetitive work and gates in place, course 6 teaches you to take the method to clients: diagnosis, plan, delivery, and report.

rodape: INEMA.CLUB · open and free content · INEMA Learning v7.2 format · eventos.inema.pro/inemaseo · inemaSEO method (MIT) · inema.club

inicio.titulo: With Agents: Claude Code and Codex Doing the Repetitive Work
inicio.lead: Audit, extract, apply in batches, check, and report: the repetitive part of SEO fits in an agent that runs through your subscription. In eight lessons, you build that line with the method's open scripts, an anti-fabrication check that discards what the AI made up, and two gates where only you decide.
inicio.capa_alt: A developer at a wooden desk jots a checklist in a notebook next to a laptop with the terminal open.
inicio.aulas_sub: In the order of the work: build the line, audit, extract, apply in batches, check, report, choose tools, and keep a record of what went wrong.

itens: People who finished courses 1 to 3 of the program and want to take the repetitive work off their hands.
Technical people or devs who already use the terminal and want Claude Code or Codex to do SEO safely.
People who have already tried leaving an AI "doing SEO on its own" and watched it make things up, duplicate, or touch things it shouldn't.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: A line of agents with two human gates and an AGENTS.md with the project's rules.
Audit and extraction through the subscription, with an anti-fabrication check that discards the made-up item.
Batch operations with dry-run, marker, and skipping a dirty repository, and push only after the gate.
A weekly report read by an agent that proposes, and you approve.

blocos.t: Where this course fits in the inemaSEO Program
itens: 1 Foundation, 2 Content, and 3 Measurement: the groundwork, pages with first-hand data, and the number that matters. This course automates what they teach you to do by hand.
4 In the AIs: official AI dashboards and the question battery.
5 With Agents (this course): agents doing the repetitive work, with gates. 6 Professional: the method as a service for clients.
All of them follow the inemaSEO method, open (MIT), applied on the INEMA portal, news site, and events site.
